--- # Minimal redirect layout for /go/ campaign links. Deliberately NOT the site # layout: no header/footer, no analytics. Static hosting can't issue a real 302, # so this forwards client-side (instant meta-refresh + JS). The destination # carries UTM params, so Google Analytics attributes the visit on arrival — this # hop stays invisible to GA (no gtag here, noindex so search engines skip it). # # _go/*.md files are GENERATED by scripts/build_go.py from # _data/campaign_codes.yml. Front matter each _go/.md provides: # to: destination — site-relative ("/for/foo/") or absolute URL # utm_source: e.g. linkedin (default: "go") # utm_medium: e.g. paid-social (default: "referral") # utm_campaign: e.g. mortgage-q3 (default: the code itself) # utm_content: optional # utm_term: optional # utm_id: optional; the code itself on generated files (GA4 "Session # campaign ID"), so a visit traces back to its exact code # note: optional short human label for the assigned code # description: optional fuller internal detail for lead tagging # `note` and `description` are internal-only: they never appear in the URL, the # redirect, or GA — they document what a code is being used for. --- {%- comment -%} Split off any #section first: browsers never send the fragment, so the UTM params must go before it or GA would never see them. {%- endcomment -%} {%- assign target = page.to | default: "/" -%} {%- assign base = target | split: "#" | first | default: "" -%} {%- assign fragment = target | remove_first: base -%} {%- comment -%} Resolve destination base (absolute pass-through, else site-absolute). {%- endcomment -%} {%- unless base contains "://" -%}{%- assign base = base | absolute_url -%}{%- endunless -%} {%- if base contains "?" -%}{%- assign sep = "&" -%}{%- else -%}{%- assign sep = "?" -%}{%- endif -%} {%- assign code = page.path | split: "/" | last | split: "." | first -%} {%- capture query -%}utm_source={{ page.utm_source | default: "go" | cgi_escape }}&utm_medium={{ page.utm_medium | default: "referral" | cgi_escape }}&utm_campaign={{ page.utm_campaign | default: code | cgi_escape }}{%- if page.utm_content %}&utm_content={{ page.utm_content | cgi_escape }}{% endif %}{%- if page.utm_term %}&utm_term={{ page.utm_term | cgi_escape }}{% endif %}{%- if page.utm_id %}&utm_id={{ page.utm_id | cgi_escape }}{% endif %}{%- endcapture -%} {%- assign dest = base | append: sep | append: query | append: fragment -%} Redirecting…
